title: Genetically modified cows
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What potential benefit would make genetically modifying farm animals acceptable to you?
Do you see a moral difference between selective breeding and genetic modification?
Should genetically modified animal products be clearly labelled for consumers?
What risks should scientists prove are under control before such animals are widely used?
If genetic modification could make cows produce less methane, would that change your opinion?
